comparison.objective: Find and replace two faulty circuit parts; candidate fractures and retrieves four tangs from installed threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Fault diagnosis and component replacement versus coaxial mandrel insertion, bimanual striking, overload avoidance, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Faulty circuit parts identified and replaced versus four notch fractures, four recovered tangs, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Diagnosis and replacement are meaningfully different from impact-driven tang removal. The record lacks component identities, replacement mechanics, scoring criteria, and all spec versions.
